assertions.expected: a collected hit remains pending during its collection tick

assertions.expected: an applied Slime or Huesoguardia impact assigns the enemy_damage clip to an audio voice

assertions.expected: two Huesoguardias enter Dead after melee impacts

assertions.name: Victory requires clearing both configured encounter waves
assertions.expected: Victory; zero living enemies; player alive
